stem: Identify the logic gate given in the circuit:
solution:
Output $Y = \overline{\overline{A}\cdot\overline{B}} = \overline{\overline{A+B}}$ (By De-Morgan Law)

$\therefore Y = A + B$

This Boolean expression represents OR gate.

stem: The temperature of an ideal gas is increased from $200$ K to $800$ K. If r.m.s. speed of gas at $200$ K is $v_0$. Then, r.m.s. speed of the gas at $800$ K will be:
solution:
$v_{rms} = \sqrt{\dfrac{3RT}{M}} \Rightarrow v_{rms} \propto \sqrt{T}$

Increasing temperature 4 times, rms speed gets doubled.

One main scale division of a vernier caliper is equal to $m$ units. If $n^{th}$ division of main scale coincides with $(n+1)^{th}$ division of vernier scale, the least count of the vernier caliper is:
Pressure inside two soap bubbles are $1.01$ and $1.02$ atmosphere, respectively. The ratio of their volumes is:
solution:
$\Delta P_1 = P_1 - P_0 = 0.01 = \dfrac{4T}{R_1}$ and $\Delta P_2 = P_2 - P_0 = 0.02 = \dfrac{4T}{R_2}$

Dividing, $\dfrac{1}{2} = \dfrac{R_2}{R_1} \Rightarrow R_1 = 2R_2$

$V = \dfrac{4}{3}\pi R^3 \Rightarrow \dfrac{V_1}{V_2} = \dfrac{R_1^3}{R_2^3} = \dfrac{(2R_2)^3}{R_2^3} = 8$

stem: A microwave of wavelength $2.0$ cm falls normally on a slit of width $4.0$ cm. The angular spread of the central maxima of the diffraction pattern obtained on a screen $1.5$ m away from the slit, will be:

A solid metallic cube having total surface area $24\,\text{m}^2$ is uniformly heated. If its temperature is increased by $10^\circ$C, calculate the increase in volume of the cube. (Given $\alpha = 5.0 \times 10^{-4}\,^\circ\text{C}^{-1}$)

Two bodies of mass $1$ kg and $3$ kg have position vectors $\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} + \hat{k}$ and $-3\hat{i} - 2\hat{j} + \hat{k}$ respectively. The magnitude of position vector of centre of mass of this system will be similar to the magnitude of vector:
solution:
$\vec{r}_{com} = \dfrac{m_1\vec{r}_1 + m_2\vec{r}_2}{m_1 + m_2} = \dfrac{1(\hat{i}+2\hat{j}+\hat{k}) + 3(-3\hat{i}-2\hat{j}+\hat{k})}{1+3} = -2\hat{i} - \hat{j} + \hat{k}$

$|\vec{r}_{com}| = \sqrt{4+1+1} = \sqrt{6}$

Check: $\hat{i} - 2\hat{j} + \hat{k}: \sqrt{6}$; $-3\hat{i}-2\hat{j}+\hat{k}: \sqrt{14}$; $-2\hat{i}+2\hat{k}: \sqrt{8}$; $-2\hat{i}-\hat{j}+2\hat{k}: 3$

Correct answer is (A).

stem: The speed of sound in oxygen at S.T.P. will be approximately: (Given, $R = 8.3\,\text{J K}^{-1}$, $\gamma = 1.4$)
One molar concentration of a solution represents :
options: 1 mole of solute in 1 kg of solution.
1 mole of solute in 1 L of solution.
1 mole of solvent in 1 kg of solution.
1 mole of solvent in 1 L of solution.
solution: $1\,\text{M} = 1$ mole of solute in 1 L solution.

stem: In the chemical reaction $\text{A} \rightarrow \text{B}$, what is the order of the reaction? Given that, the rate of reaction doubles if the concentration of A is increased four times.

The correct order of melting points of the following salts is

LiCl (I), LiF (II), LiI (III)
solution: Smaller the size of anion, smaller is the covalent character and higher will be its melting point. Hence, the order of melting point of lithium salts is $\text{LiF} > \text{LiCl} > \text{LiI}$.
